description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the SegmentHDCommonImage operation in the image segmentation (imageseg) category
description_zh: 本文介绍分割抠图（imageseg）类目下的通用高清分割SegmentHDCommonImage的语法及示例
name: SegmentHDCommonImage

parameters.help_en: The image URL. Use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS URLs in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

Data.description_en:
The returned result data.
To obtain this data, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation after the asynchronous task succeeds, and then deserialize the Result field in JSON format
Data.description_zh:
返回的结果数据内容。
该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

ImageUrl.description_en:
The URL of the result image.
After image segmentation, a four-channel PNG image is returned without compression. The image dimensions remain unchanged, but the file size increases.
This URL is temporary and valid for 30 minutes. It becomes inaccessible after expiration. To retain the file long-term or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
ImageUrl.description_zh:
结果图像的URL地址。
抠图之后返回四通道PNG图，无压缩，图像尺寸保持不变，图像体积会变大。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The prompt message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
